claims: Pip is the recommended command-line package installer for Python.
Pip allows users to install, manage, and uninstall software libraries from the Python Package Index (PyPI) and other repositories.
Pip is included with Python 3.4+ installations.
The purpose of Pip is to install and manage additional libraries and dependencies that are not part of the standard Python library.
Pip list lists all installed packages.
Pip show <package> shows information about a package.
Pip freeze outputs installed packages in requirements.txt format.
Pip was developed as the standard tool for the Python Packaging Authority (PyPA).
Pip was developed to replace older tools like easy_install.
